{{Quote|&hellip;miserable, monstrous, misbehaving brats! I can't stand it anymore! If I don't get a babysitter, you don't get any supper!&raquo;<br />&laquo;Hmm. Don't worry, my dear. I've just had an evil inspiration.|translated=1|Urgah's ultimatum gives Gorneesh an idea|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
Despite her royal pedigree, the '''child''' of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Urgah]]&mdash;rulers of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] who lived in a [[Dulok Swamp|swamp]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]&mdash;was a troublemaker. The [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] joined her [[Unidentified Dulok cub 1|two]] [[Unidentified Dulok cub 3|siblings]] in harassing their [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to the point that the Queen ordered her husband to find a babysitter. Accordingly, Gorneesh had the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] captured to watch the three children. When a group of [[entertainer]]s known as the [[Travelling Jindas]] arrived to play for the [[City/Legends|village]], the Dulok pups were in attendance; thus, they witnessed Latara's friends rescue her from Gorneesh and Urgah's clutches. During the events, which occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Dulok was a toddler and wore a [[Color/Legends|pink]] shawl similar to that worn by Urgah. She had already developed physical features consistent with those of her [[Species/Legends|species]], such as green [[Hair/Legends|fur]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Watch it! Get away, little bark eaters! Oh, ''kvark.''|translated=1|Latara, upon being tackled by Gorneesh and Urgah's children|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
[[File:DulokBratBitingLeg-TTJ.png|thumb|left|The Dulok Princess's mischief drove Queen Urgah to demand a babysitter.]]
Born to [[Parent/Legends|parents]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and [[Urgah]], respectively the [[King/Legends|king]] and [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], the Dulok child was a mere toddler in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. One day in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM" /> the child, wearing a [[Color/Legends|light-pink]] shawl, joined [[Unidentified Dulok cub 1|her sibling]] and [[Unidentified Dulok cub 3|another sibling]] as they terrorized their mother while the Queen tried to do chores in the royal hut in the [[Dulok Swamp]]. For her part in the mischief, the [[Prince/Legends|Princeess]] grasped Urgah's left [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and gnawed on her knee. With children still attached, Urgah ordered her husband to find a babysitter, lest he go hungry at suppertime.<ref name="TTJ" />

The King sent out a [[Unidentified Dulok (X)|pair]] of [[Unidentified Dulok (O)|guards]] to nab an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], a [[City/Legends|settlement]] in the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] nearby. The [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] later came back with a young, gray-furred Ewok named [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], tied up and ready to be put to work. Gorneesh initiated what he considered her "[[Torture/Legends|torture]]" by introducing her to the trio of Dulok cubs. The shawl-wearing toddler joined her siblings in welcoming their new babysitter with a body slam and floor wrestling match.<ref name="TTJ" />

That evening the Dulok Princess and her two siblings dragged Latara to the front row of a performance by the [[Travelling Jindas]], a band of wandering [[Entertainer|performers]] who had arrived in the swamp that day. The pups stood relatively still for the show, although they did join their peers in heckling certain acts. When [[Trebla]], a [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] [[Magic/Legends|magician]], appeared, the shawl-wearing child was left with her parents and siblings as the performer pulled Latara onto the stage to be his assistant. The Ewok was then spirited away as the Jindas rapidly packed up and left the swamp; indeed, Latara's friends&mdash;the Ewoks [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], all in Jinda costumes&mdash;had organized the show as a cover to save their friend from child-watching [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="TTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:LataraBabysitting-TTJ.png|thumb|right|The Dulok child and her siblings joined their fellows in jeering the Jindas' performance.]]
{{Quote|I'm sure you know how we Duloks love to torture Ewoks. Well, your torture will be the most exquisite of all: babysitting the Dulok brats.|translated=1|Gorneesh, to Latara|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
As a toddler in 3 ABY,<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Gorneesh and Urgah's daughter was shorter than the typical Dulok's height of 1.35 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]; she stood only knee-high to most adult members of the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="height" /> Nevertheless, the cub sported the gray skin, brown eyebrows, brown [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and green [[Hair/Legends|fur]] typical among Duloks. She also sported white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. At the time that Urgah demanded a babysitter for the child, the Princess wore a light-pink shawl not unlike the one worn by the family matriarch. The Dulok toddler also sported a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] hairband. She had only two prominent [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], both canines that poked upward from her lower [[Skeleton/Legends|jaw]].<ref name="TTJ" />

Like the rest of the brood, the Dulok Princess was rambunctious and disobedient such that having to care for her was considered a form of torture. In one instance, the child clung to Urgah's leg and bit her knee, all the while laughing sinisterly. When the child's parents enlisted the Ewok Latara to babysit her, the pup joined her siblings in tackling the new arrival and pummeling her on the ground of Gorneesh and Urgah's dwelling. Later, however, the toddler attentively watched a performance by the Travelling Jindas.<ref name="TFTEW">''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Travelling Jindas]]'', a first-season episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], introduced the Dulok Princess when it was first aired on [[October 5]], [[1985]].<ref name="SWC">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> The episode, directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]] and written by [[Bob Carrau]],<ref name="TTJ" /> later became part of the [[Star Wars home video releases|DVD]] feature film ''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]'', first released in [[2004]].<ref name="TFTEW" />
